title: mtpc
description: The .mtpc format, version 4. See mtpc.md for what each part means and the rules a schema cannot express.

shared.description: Attribute values every shape of one kind has (a kind, or instance:motif), left out of those shapes; see mtpc.md.

type-table.description: Each structured type the file uses, written once; see mtpc.md.

in.description: For a listener on a shape or a term, the one view whose body holds it; for a control, the views it belongs to (mtpc.md, "Objects"). Left out for a listener on its own view, and for a control whose source gives none.

type.description: A type, or the position of a structured one in type-table.
